failures: atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha ! yogaṃ yuñjanmadāś
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ yajjñātvā na pūnaḥ kiṃcijjñātavyam
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtira
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryat
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidastu dhanañjaya mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇiga
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prakāśaḥ śaśisūryayoḥ praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe paur
puṇyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ gandho'smi tejaścā'smi vibhāvasau jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścā'
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejasteja
balaṃ balavatāmasmi kāmarāgavivarjitam dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣ
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye matta eveti tān viddhi natvahaṃ teṣu
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ par
ityāha daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmatita
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāś
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtinaḥ sadā ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bha
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca m
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me mataḥ āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānutta
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavān māṃ prapadyate vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudu
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tām
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate labhate ca tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitā
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānt
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayaman
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavya
vedā'haṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna bhaviṣyanti ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na ka
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata sarvabhūtāni sammohaṃ sarge yānti par
yeṣāṃ tvantaṃ gataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karm
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryu
atra saṃgrahaślokaḥ sphuṭaṃ bhagavato bhaktirāhitā kalpamañjarī sādhakecchāsamuc
